risk_rule: 0.36% current mark-to-market equity per fresh setup; recycled risk only after older live setups are protected at BE

baseline_high_return.architecture: UNION4 BRK+EXP+PULL+FRACTAL + WEEK_PLUS_ANY + POC + sequential current-equity sizing

best_high_winrate_partial_runner.win_definition: final net setup R > 0 after partials, runner and modeled cost; T1 touch alone does not count as a win

features: true trades per second and change percent
true_cme_pipeline.anti_lookahead: features become available only at completed 1m/5m/15m bucket close
true_cme_pipeline.blocker: Real CME data retrieval requires DATABENTO_API_KEY; no proxy fallback is allowed

truth_labels.current_public_xau_m1_microstructure: proxy only; tick_volume is broker quote activity, not exchange trades/order book
truth_labels.databento_gc: true CME trade/order-book flow when authenticated data is fetched
truth_labels.current_return_results: M5 OHLC research simulation; not final tick-by-tick broker execution
